about_the_game:
🏪 Welcome to Tiny Town Market Simulator!

Set in a miniature toy town that comes to life inside a magical dome, Tiny Town Market Simulator puts you in the shoes of a small merchant determined to grow his own shop into the most beloved market in town.

Start from a humble stall and transform your business into a thriving success.

Grow crops, raise animals, craft handmade goods, buy upgrades, and manage every corner of your shop in this relaxing yet engaging management simulator.

🌱 Buy, Grow, Craft, Sell, Repeat

• Choose whether to buy raw materials or produce them yourself.

• Plant and harvest fresh crops to keep your shelves stocked.

• Raise animals to collect milk, eggs, and other valuable resources.

• Use crafting stations to transform raw ingredients into profitable goods.

• Manage prices, stock, and customer satisfaction to build your reputation.

🛠️ Expand and Improve

Invest your profits wisely to unlock new opportunities:

• Shop Upgrades – expand, decorate, and attract more customers.

• Farm & Stable Expansions – grow more crops and raise more animals.

• Crafting Area Improvements – unlock new recipes and boost production efficiency.

• Warehouse Extensions – store more goods and optimize your logistics.

💬 Dynamic Customers & Reputation

Every day brings new faces and new challenges.

Serve customers quickly, hire employees, keep your shop clean, and watch your reputation rise — or face the consequences if your market becomes too chaotic!

☀️ A Living World

From sunrise to closing time, the rhythm of the day drives your routine.

Plan your tasks, manage your time, and enjoy the satisfaction of watching your business grow day after day.

🧩 Key Features

• 🌱 Farming, crafting, and trading systems

• 🐮 Animal raising and production chains

• 🏗️ Deep upgrade trees for shop, farm, crafting area, warehouse, inventory, and more!

• 💸 Balanced economy between buying, producing, and selling — choose your own path to success!

• 🧍‍♂️ Dynamic customers and procedural reputation system

• 🕒 Day/night cycle and time management gameplay

• 📖 In-game mini-wiki with all the information you need

💖 About the Developer

Tiny Town Market Simulator is a passion project developed by ZimonG — a solo Italian developer who loves management and simulation games.

A carefully crafted project built to grow over time through regular updates and community support.

Your feedback and participation are essential to shaping the future of Tiny Town Market Simulator!

✨ Join the journey and follow the growth of the most lively market in town!
